node.text:
😳 When a wall of spray drops visibility to 2%, elite drivers stop looking at the road and start navigating by a mental map of peripheral landmarks.

By anchoring their position to brake markers, catch fencing, or even gaps in the trees, they maintain triple-digit speeds through a literal whiteout.

This sensory bypass allows them to “feel” the racing line through the chassis rather than relying on sight alone.

Since the asphalt is effectively invisible at 300km/h, do you think rain racing is more a test of physical bravery or pure spatial memory?

What are your thoughts? 🤔💭

( Media: Formula 1 )

node.text:
Neuroplasticity is your brain’s ability to rewire itself through experience, repetition, and learning.

Your brain is not fixed, it’s constantly adapting to what you consistently practice.

Most people quit during phase 3 (repetition) right before the brain fully strengthens a new neural pathway.

That’s the moment it still feels hard. That’s the moment it doesn’t feel natural yet.
That’s the moment it’s easiest to go back to old patterns.

But if you stay consistent, your brain will eventually do what it’s designed to do,  make the new behavior your default.

Change isn’t magic. It’s your brain learning a new way.

#brainscience #mentalwellbeing #therapistthoughts #healingenergy #quantumhealing

Justice gets loud in the courtroom. ⚖️😂
🎬 Movie: My Cousin Vinny
📖 About: When two college kids are wrongly accused of murder in a small Southern town, their only hope is Vinny—an inexperienced, fast-talking New York lawyer who’s never tried a case. My Cousin Vinny is a sharp, hilarious courtroom comedy about confidence, smarts, and never underestimating the underdog.
📍 Available on: Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV

Why are some faces attractive and some aren’t? 

You may think it is because of genetics 

But the reality is that beauty has a science 

Beauty has a framework 

And you can work on these individual factors at any age to become as “attractive” as possible 

Work on developing your maxilla, expanding your palate, training your muscles in the face and releasing the myofascia and you’ll soon realise that 99% of facial issues stem from these root causes 

Focus on your structural health

node.text:
Pace Morby has openly said that hiring women was a strategic business decision — not a publicity move.

Early on, he noticed that women on his team consistently outperformed in the skills that actually drive real estate success: clear communication, emotional intelligence, organization, and follow-through.

They were better at building trust with sellers, navigating sensitive conversations, and managing details without ego.

In contrast to aggressive, male-dominated sales environments, his female hires focused on process, consistency, and long-term relationships — leading to higher close rates and fewer issues.

The results made the decision obvious.
Business isn’t about tradition. It’s about performance.

node.text:
In 1991, we watched two machines talk to each other in Terminator 2: Judgment Day. At the time, it felt like pure science fiction — the T-800 and the T-1000 mimicking human voices, stripping away emotion, verifying reality through subtle conversational cues. But beneath the action spectacle was something deeper: one of cinema’s earliest portrayals of AI speaking directly to AI. No humans involved. No passwords. No faces. Just data validating data. By copying John and Janelle’s voices, the machines weren’t simply communicating — they were authenticating, probing for behavioral tells, running a kind of machine-to-machine Turing test disguised as small talk.

Thirty-five years later, that scene feels less fictional and more prophetic. What looked like Skynet paranoia now resembles our daily reality: deepfakes cloning voices, AI systems verifying identity in milliseconds, autonomous algorithms checking one another before we even notice. Terminator 2 wasn’t just foreshadowing the future of warfare — it was hinting at the future of truth itself. A world where verification happens between machines, and reality can be negotiated by code. And that future isn’t coming. It’s here.

Whites is a British comedy that aired on BBC Two in 2010, set in the kitchen of a country house hotel. It stars Alan Davies as Roland White, a once-promising chef now struggling with confidence and ambition, alongside Darren Boyd and Katherine Parkinson as part of the chaotic kitchen team navigating demanding guests and internal tensions.

Despite positive reviews for its writing and performances, Whites ran for just one series of six episodes and was not renewed. Over time, it has gained a cult following, particularly among fans of British sitcoms and hospitality workers, for its realistic yet comedic portrayal of kitchen pressure, workplace dynamics, and the gap between culinary ambition and reality.

node.text:
Supporting your brain health isn’t an isolated process.

It ofcourse asks for a holistic approach in which you target your entire body.

But if you try to incorporate these elements weekly, I’m sure that results will speak for themselves over time & you will be ahead of everyone else.

And that’s what comes from someone (me) who suffered significant brain damage in childhood & teenage years.

Mostly caused by physical abuse (10+ years), multiple concussions, damage from alcohol & drugs, and neuroinflammation from shedding, among some other , less significant factors.

However, because of consistent effort, to a great extent related to what’s described in this post, I was able to reverse most of the damage & heal my brain. 

They will never tell you how to regenerate your brain, but I did because I’m a living example of what’s possible with our innate self-healing capabilities.

Are you ready to let every brain cell of yours thrive far into your 100s? :)

#wellnessthatworks #healthandwellnessjourney #healthandwellnesstips #brainhealthmatters #brainhealth 

*Educational purposes only. Not medical advice*

node.text:
One of the saddest stories ever put on the screen! ❤️‍🩹

Turtles Can Fly (2004) is a Kurdish-Iranian film directed by Bahman Ghobadi, set in a refugee camp on the Iraqi-Turkish border just before the U.S. invasion of Iraq. It follows Satellite, a clever boy who leads other children collecting and disarming landmines to survive. Filmed with real child refugees, the movie feels raw and authentic and was the first film shot in Iraq after the fall of Saddam Hussein. Rather than focusing on spectacle, it shows war through the quiet pain and resilience of children. Praised for its poetic realism and natural performances, the film delivers a powerful and heartbreaking message about the human cost of war and the persistence of hope.

Bro, imagine when you hit your first $100K month.
Not the money itself. Imagine what that moment represents.
You just proved to yourself that everything you believed was possible actually is. You just validated years of work that nobody saw. You just became the person you said you’d become.
Your parents don’t have to worry about money anymore. You can retire them. You can buy your dad his dream car. You can take care of your family the way they took care of you.
You’re not chasing opportunities anymore. They’re coming to you. You’re not convincing people. They’re already sold. You’re not wondering if it’s going to work. You know it works because you built it.
That’s not luck. That’s the result of refusing to quit when it got hard. That’s execution compounding. That’s discipline becoming destiny.
And the crazy part? $100K is just the beginning. Because once you hit it once, you know exactly how to do it again. And scale it. And multiply it.
So stop thinking it’s impossible. Stop wondering if you’re capable. You are. You just have to work like you already know it’s inevitable.
Your first $100K month is coming. The only question is: are you willing to do what it takes to get there?
Comment AMEN if you’re ready to make it happen.

I’m trying but I have no like minded individuals like me… They are comfortable with where they are at or working that 9-5… I HATE WORKING FOR 120$ A DAY WHEN I KNOW I CAN BE MAKING 1000+ A DAY…
Money is of little importance in the larger play of things. Money comes to those that know how to manifest it , only love and experience matter in the universe.

Everyone saying 100k in one month isnt shit obviously didnt do much to feel accomplished. Youre making people like us who dont have the luxury to go out and decompress bc we HAVE to work everyday or even try anymore. Humble yourselves and be grateful that you can see things most people wont. Congratulate yourselves and be happy.
You’ll be desensitized by then. 10k, 100k, 1mil all the same. Sad but true. With that being said, it does feel good to take care of your family.

The Apprentice UK repeatedly shows how business confidence does not always translate into real-world execution.

Contestants often arrive with strong academic backgrounds, corporate experience, and polished presentations, yet struggle with practical tasks such as pricing, branding, or understanding customers.Analysts note the show highlights a common gap in business training, where theoretical knowledge and management language can mask weak operational judgment and decision-making under pressure 

The format reinforces a broader reality of entrepreneurship: success depends less on sounding competent and more on delivering outcomes when conditions are unpredictable.

Fact: In the historical drama Mary Queen of Scots, Saoirse Ronan portrays Mary, Queen of Scots, highlighting the queen’s intelligence and political awareness during her return to Scotland.

In one notable moment, Mary confidently speaks in English while addressing the Scottish court, despite having spent many years in France. The scene emphasizes her effort to connect with her people and establish authority in a court that is uncertain about her rule.

This moment stands out because it reflects Mary’s determination to lead and adapt, showing her strength as a young queen navigating political tension and cultural differences.

Most people try to “fix” their hormones without ever supporting them at the basics.

Your body is building, signaling, and detoxing hormones all day long. It does this with the nutrients you give it.

If you’ve been feeling off, it’s usually not random. It’s a signal that something deeper isn’t being supported. 👇🏼

🥑 CORTISOL • stress + energy rhythm
Your wake up signal and inflammation regulator. Dysregulated = wired at night, exhausted by morning.

🌿 ESTROGEN • metabolism + detox
It’s not just about levels. It’s about how well you clear it. Fiber and cruciferous veggies are non negotiable.

🌙 PROGESTERONE • calm + recovery
Supports sleep, mood, and nervous system balance. Low levels show up as anxiety, irritability, and restless nights.

🔥 TESTOSTERONE • drive + strength
Fuels muscle, motivation, and resilience. Chronically under eating or avoiding fat will tank it fast.

🍞 INSULIN • blood sugar control
Determines how your body uses or stores energy. This is where most hormone issues actually start.

🦋 THYROID • metabolic control center
Regulates everything: metabolism, temperature, hair, energy. Depends on iodine and selenium, and most people are low on both.

You don’t need a more complicated plan.

You need to stop skipping the foundations your hormones depend on.

This is what I mapped out for you 👆🏼

Sometimes extraordinary moments appear in the most unexpected situations. In 2015 a former Google employee noticed something unusual when one of the most valuable domains on the internet briefly appeared available for purchase at an incredibly low price.

For a short time he technically owned a website recognized worldwide. Instead of taking advantage of the rare opportunity he chose honesty and immediately informed the company’s security team about the situation.

His decision reflected integrity and responsibility in a moment where many people might have acted differently. Choosing transparency over personal benefit demonstrated how strong ethical values can guide important decisions.

The company later rewarded his honesty and he requested the reward be donated to educational programs supporting students in India. This story reminds us that true character is revealed through actions especially when honesty becomes the easier choice.

What are your thoughts on this?

node.text:
Okara AI has recently gained significant attention for its "Think before telling AI everything" campaign, which positions the platform as a privacy-focused alternative to mainstream giants like OpenAI or Google. The ad highlights a growing concern in 2026: "Shadow AI," where employees inadvertently leak corporate secrets or personal data by uploading them to public models for summarization or analysis. Okara's pitch is that users can access powerful open-source models like Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek within a "Zero-Knowledge" vault that prevents their data from being used for training or viewed by the provider.

The platform distinguishes itself by hosting these models on privately managed servers and using client-side encryption, meaning the keys to unlock your data stay on your device. This approach appeals specifically to "public thinkers" — founders, lawyers, and researchers — who need high-level intelligence but cannot risk their proprietary drafts or sensitive client info becoming part of a public model's next update. By offering a unified workspace where you can switch between over 30 different models without losing context, Okara aims to provide the utility of a "Chief Marketing Officer" or "Research Assistant" without the traditional privacy trade-off.

node.text:
An area of interest I’ve been exploring for some time now: diet as a source of bioactive peptides and their effects on overall health and well-being throughout life.

Highly underfunded and understudied concept.

Little is known about the quantities, bioavailability, and bio activity of the peptides from foods, but I believe the potential is immense.

Nose to tail eating and diets rich in fermented foods built some of the most robust groups of people throughout time, and I theorize peptides through foods played a role in their health, resilience, and physical excellence.

New article introducing my exploration of this topic released today. You can comment “peptide article” if you want the link sent to your DMs :)

API Protocols you should know 👇
✔ REST → Standard, simple, stateless
✔ GraphQL → Flexible queries
✔ WebSockets → Full-duplex real-time
✔ gRPC → Fast & efficient communication
✔ Webhooks → Event-driven callbacks
✔ MQTT / AMQP → Messaging systems

node.text: Cinema varies greatly across countries, each developing distinctive traditions, storytelling approaches, visual styles, and cultural emphases that reflect their societies and histories. The United States, through **Hollywood**, dominates globally with its emphasis on high-production-value blockbusters, narrative-driven genres like action, science fiction, and drama, innovative special effects, and star-centered entertainment that often prioritizes broad appeal and emotional escapism. India stands out for its massive output, particularly through **Bollywood** and regional industries, characterized by vibrant musical sequences, melodramatic plots blending romance, family values, and social themes, elaborate song-and-dance numbers, and a focus on emotional intensity and moral lessons rooted in cultural traditions. France excels in auteur-driven art cinema, known for intellectual depth, experimental techniques, poetic realism, philosophical undertones, and a strong emphasis on character psychology and social commentary, often supported by state funding for creative freedom. Japan contributes profound stylistic innovation through precise visual composition, themes of honor, nature, existentialism, family dynamics, and a masterful blend of live-action and animation traditions that explore human emotions with subtlety and restraint. Italy has given the world influential movements like neorealism, focusing on everyday life, social issues, and authentic locations, alongside operatic grandeur in historical epics and stylish genre works that highlight passion, family, and moral complexity. South Korea has risen prominently with technically polished productions blending intense thrillers, heartfelt dramas, and genre hybrids, often incorporating sharp social critique, family conflicts, and dynamic pacing that resonates universally while staying grounded in local sensibilities. Other notable traditions include Iran's poetic, minimalist approach emphasizing human dignity, censorship navigation, and subtle metaphor; Germany's expressionist roots with dramatic lighting and psychological intensity; Sweden's introspective, atmospheric explorations of existential and moral question

Peak detailing by Aditya Dhar in Dhurandhar 2😂
Let’s uncover one of the most dangerous chemicals ever known in the history of Mankind—dimethylmercury. 
I’m taking you through the first shocking case that changed the face of toxicology forever. As an engineering student, reading medical literature gives me an adrenaline rush like no other and reading this Medical  case in my childhood has given me trauma like no other.😱
Dimethylmercury also plays an important role in the movie “Dhurandhar 2.” Medical mysteries —this is science at its most gripping! 

#science #medical #dhurandhar2 #instagramreels #literature

But I'm not even wrong maine toh bachpan mai touch kiii thii mercury and heard k poisnous hoti hai, my mother warned me but still I remember trying collecting small drops of it 🙃. It's been more than a decade since then, being science student myself ik it's risky but never think of it with such details.

Who doesn’t wanna sound like Bane?

Helium is known for making voices sound high-pitched because it is much less dense than air, allowing sound waves to travel faster through the vocal tract and raising the resonance frequencies. In contrast, sulfur hexafluoride is significantly denser than air, which slows down sound waves and lowers those resonance frequencies, producing a much deeper, heavier-sounding voice. The effect doesn’t actually change the vocal cords themselves, but rather how sound resonates and travels through the air inside the mouth and throat.

This contrast highlights a basic principle of acoustics: the speed of sound in a gas depends on its physical properties, especially density and molecular weight. While the phenomenon is real and often demonstrated in science experiments, inhaling gases like sulfur hexafluoride can be dangerous because it can displace oxygen and increase the risk of suffocation. The dramatic shift in voice shows how small changes in environment can significantly alter how sound is perceived.

node.text:
When I saw that video, many people claimed it showed the speed of light — but what it actually demonstrates is the speed of electricity. ⚡

Both are incredibly fast, but they aren’t the same. Light travels at nearly 300,000 km per second in a vacuum. Electricity, however — specifically the electric field moving through a wire — travels at a speed that depends on the conductor material and is usually a fraction of the speed of light.

What the experiment really shows is an electrical signal moving through a long cable, turning on lights or triggering sounds one after another. We’re not watching photons racing through space, but rather the effect of an electrical signal traveling almost instantly inside the wire.

It’s a powerful visual way to understand how electricity works in the technology we use every single day.

#physics #electricity #speedoflight #nasa #explore

Numbers in this video are rough estimates to build intuition, not exact figures.

In reality, training cost depends on many factors like dataset size and quality, number of tokens, model architecture, hardware setup (type and number of GPUs), system efficiency, parallelization strategy, and how many times you retrain or tune the model.

Also, training doesn’t happen on a single GPU. Large models are trained on hundreds or even thousands of GPUs in parallel. So instead of one GPU running for 30,000 hours, it’s many GPUs running together for a much shorter time.

GPU pricing also varies a lot depending on provider, availability, and scale. The $3/hour number is not universal.

Another important point: model performance is not just about the number of parameters. Data quality, architecture design, and training techniques matter just as much, if not more.

Even reported numbers like GPT-4’s parameter count are not officially confirmed, so take such figures as approximations.

So don’t take the exact numbers literally. Focus on the bigger idea: building large AI models requires massive compute, high-quality data, and multiple iterations.

node.text: The image features a two-panel infographic illustrating the difference between equality and equity through the metaphor of bicycle riding. In the top panel, labeled "Equality," four individuals of different heights and physical abilities are all given the exact same standard bicycle. This results in an unusable situation for a person in a wheelchair, a very tall person, and a small child, while only fitting one average-sized individual. The bottom panel, labeled "Equity," shows the same four people provided with bicycles tailored to their specific needs: a hand-powered cycle for the person with a disability, a large frame for the tall person, a standard bike for the average-sized person, and a small bike for the child. An accompanying social media caption summarizes the message by stating that treating people fairly often requires treating them differently to ensure they have the same access to the same opportunities. The visual effectively simplifies complex social justice concepts into a clear, functional comparison of standardized versus individualized support.

On the girl’s arm is a sensor that is sensing action potentials from the muscle fibers in her arm muscles - when she flexes her arm, these fibers fire, and the sensor detects it ⚡️ 

This signal travels to a device that is connected to the electrodes on my arm, so when she moves her arm, the electrodes on my arm activate, shocking my muscle fibers and forcing them to activate and contract, so she has full control of my arm 😵‍💫

As you could see, there wasn’t anything I could do to stop this from happening hahaha I was completely at her mercy 

Pretty cool to see the science in action, follow for more ✌️ 

#neuroscience #fyp #student #funny #science

node.text:
A powerful electromagnet can create a non-uniform magnetic field, meaning the field strength changes from one point to another. In such a field, diamagnetic materials—which weakly repel magnetic fields—experience a force pushing them away from the strongest part of the field.

The human body is mostly water, and water is diamagnetic. When the magnetic field is strong enough, it induces tiny opposing magnetic moments in your body tissues. These moments create an upward repulsive force that can counteract gravity. If this magnetic force equals the force of gravity, the object—or even a small living creature—can levitate.

This phenomenon doesn’t rely on iron or magnetism in the usual sense; it’s pure physics arising from how materials respond to magnetic fields. It’s the same principle scientists use to levitate frogs or small objects in laboratory experiments—showing that even gravity can be balanced using the right field conditions.

Sabrina Gonzalez Pasterski is often described as the next Einstein, a brilliant mind quietly shaping the future of theoretical physics. While others chase fame or fast success, she focuses on understanding the universe, dedicating her life to questions that require patience, depth, and extraordinary intellect.

Her journey began young. At fourteen, she built a functioning airplane, and at sixteen, she flew it by herself. When MIT initially rejected her, she submitted a video showcasing her work. Their response changed instantly, offering her a place the very next semester.

She went on to graduate with a perfect GPA, earning recognition from some of the greatest scientific minds, including Stephen Hawking. Instead of pursuing offers from major tech giants like Google, Facebook, or prominent entrepreneurs, she chose research, valuing truth and discovery above wealth.

Her story is a reminder that brilliance doesn’t always seek attention. True innovation often comes from those who quietly push boundaries, driven by curiosity rather than reward. Sabrina’s path shows how passion and focus can lead to world changing contributions without ever chasing the spotlight.

What are your thoughts on this?

“This happens because the Earth is a sphere, but maps like the Mercator projection flatten it onto a 2D surface. To preserve angles for navigation, distances and sizes get distorted—especially near the poles, where regions appear stretched. So even though two paths may look similar or misleading on a flat map, their actual distances on the curved Earth can be very different.”

Follow @quantum_explains for more.

node.text:
Smaller than a matchstick—yet powerful enough to save a life.

A coronary stent is a tiny metal mesh tube used to open blocked heart arteries. During a minimally invasive procedure, doctors guide it through a blood vessel to the narrowed area of a coronary artery.

Once in place, the stent expands and presses against the artery wall, restoring blood flow to the heart.

Modern drug-eluting stents go even further. They slowly release medication that helps prevent the artery from narrowing again.

Tiny device. Precision engineering.
But for millions of patients worldwide, it means more years of life and a healthier heart.

🐠🦈🐡 Did you know that reefs with cleaner wrasses have greater fish diversity? 

🩺 These tiny fish play a surprisingly huge ecological role and function like mobile health clinics, keeping other fish parasite-free. By keeping their “clients” healthy, the wrasse gets food. 

🤓 These wrasses often clean predator fish, which stay remarkably calm and do not attack or eat the wrasses.

node.accessibility_caption: Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of text that says 'H's H'smom mom @aiishadahir X.com com TELEPORTATION IN ISLAM'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of beach, ocean and text that says 'H's mom @aiishadahir X.com Most people think teleportation belongs to science fiction. But Islam introduced a concept centuries ago that sounds far more advanced Tayy al-Ard (Folding of the Earth) is the Islamic metaphysical concept of teleportation, where physical distance is compressed or shrunk by divine will.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of text that says 'H'smom H's mom @aiishadahir X.com In Surah An-Naml Prophet Sulayman AS asked: "Who will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?" 27:38 He was speaking of the Queen of Sheba & wanted the throne brought to his court instantly. A powerful Jinn offered to bring it before he could stand up. But then, a human stepped in. This man didn't use muscles or magic. The Quran says he had "Knowledge of the Book." In the time it took for Sulaiman to blink, the throne was there.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of text that says 'H's mom @aiishadahir X.com Prophet Muhammad' () night journey to Jerusalem was a suspension of al terrestrial physics. He rode the Buraq, a creature whose hoof-fall landed at the farthest point its eye could see. This is travel at the speed of perception essentially rendering the destination as fast as you look at it.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be an illustration of eclipse and text that says 'H's mom @aiishadahir X.com Al-Khidri is often associated with Tayy al-Ard (Folding the Earth). He represents the Hidden Knowledge (Ilm al-Batin) that allows a person to bypass the cause- and-effect of the physical world. Notice how this story sits right in the heart of Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave). •The Youth in the Cave warped Time. •Al-Khidr warped Space. Together, they prove that for Allah, the Programmer of our reality, time and space are just variables that can be edited.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of night and text that says 'H's mom @aiishadahir X.com X. People once thought time was fixed. Then Albert Einstein changed that. He showed time is not absolute. It can slow, stretch, and vary depending on speed and gravity. What seemed solid was more flexible than imagined. The Qur'an had already trained believers to question surface-level assumptions. By reminding us that the laws we observe are not the highest authority. Allah is.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of text that says 'H'smom H's mom @aiishadahir X.com Why does the Qur'an an give us these "science-fiction" moments? To remind us that the laws of physics are just patterns & patterns are not sovereign. greater The laws of physics are real, but the Law-Maker is The same Power that transported a throne is the Power that can shift your life in a second.'.

Photo by Aiisha Dahir on April 20, 2026. May be a Twitter screenshot of text that says 'H's mom @aiishadahir X.com Not all realities are reached through power. Some are opened through understanding. The deeper message of these verses is not "learn magic." It is this: Human perception is limited.Reality is wider than what we currently grasp. And the more knowledge you gain, the more humble you should become. The question is not whether teleportation is possible. The real question is: How much of existence have we mistaken for impossible simply because we do not yet understanc it?'.

node.text:
In this clip I’m briefly acting as a human top load on a Tesla coil. Very few people in the world have ever performed this demonstration and documented it—there are only a small handful of videos showing anyone doing it safely. When someone sits on the top load, the coil’s high-frequency energy spreads across the surface of the body due to the skin effect, meaning the current stays mostly on the outside of the skin. Even so, that energy can still be absorbed in the outer layers as RF heating, which can irritate skin cells and nerve endings and leave a sunburn-like sensation across the body the next day—even noticeable on the bottoms of the feet when walking—despite little or no visible burn. My friend Tesla Explorer has probably recorded more videos and more total minutes of this demonstration than anyone else in the world, most of it done years ago, which in my mind likely makes him one of the most experienced people anywhere when it comes to this particular Tesla coil demonstration. Tesla Explorer and my friendship goes back over a decade—built on shared interests, trust, and a lot of history. Life moves forward and time creates distance sometimes, but the kind of bond built on that foundation never really fades—it just finds its way back. This clip is from a visit to my good friend’s place about eight years ago.

A data career isn’t a single role anymore.

It’s an ecosystem.

Different layers, different skills, all working together.

Here’s how the modern data world is structured 👇

- Core roles
Turning data into value through roles like analysts, engineers, and AI builders who handle everything from insights to production systems.

- Data engineering
Moving, transforming, and preparing data so it’s clean, reliable, and always available for downstream use.

- Data science & ML
Building models that learn patterns, make predictions, and solve complex problems using data.

- Analytics & BI
Presenting data in a way that drives decisions through dashboards, reports, and business-friendly insights.

- AI & LLM engineering
Creating intelligent applications using LLMs, agents, embeddings, and modern AI architectures.

- Cloud & infrastructure
Providing scalable systems and platforms where data storage, processing, and AI workloads run efficiently.

- DataOps & governance
Ensuring data is accurate, secure, traceable, and compliant across the entire lifecycle.

- Foundation skills
Core technical skills like SQL, Python, Git, and Linux that support every layer in the data stack.

What this means:
Your role is just one layer.
Your growth depends on understanding the stack around it.

Go deep in one area.
Stay aware of the entire system.

Which layer are you building depth in right now?

This image captures a persistent **internet conspiracy theory** regarding specific graphic symbols and their alleged hidden meanings. The flyer claims that these geometric designs—spirals and concentric hearts—are secret identifiers used by a predatory subculture, citing the "FBI" as a source for the imagery.
Within digital culture, this specific set of symbols is frequently the subject of "panic posting," where users share the image to warn others about hidden dangers in plain sight. However, the symbols themselves are often the focus of significant misinformation. For instance, the blue triangle spiral is frequently confused with the logo of the former tech company **Lucent Technologies** or general "geometric art" found in corporate branding. These posts highlight a broader social media phenomenon where **decontextualized information** and "official-looking" documents can rapidly go viral, fueled by parental anxiety and the internet's tendency to amplify sensationalist or conspiratorial claims without verifying the original source or context.

node.text: hey! so I accidentally went down the rabbit hole of quantum physics and I’ll never be able to look at anything the same again!!! 💫
Nice metaphor. Not how quantum mechanics works.
This is the exact post I've been wanting to make but I'm too afraid to talk about the things I actually like 😭
omg this encapsulates everything i’ve been wanting to write/put into words!! tysm 🥹 i’m so obsessed w quantum physics

to me, quantum physics doesn’t show that the world is structured in a different way than you thought, it reminds you that all the structure comes from your own mind. outside of your conceptions and categorizations, there is only raw experience. it’s not that the past, present, and future happen all at once, it’s that these concepts only make sense in a very narrow slice of ‘everyday’ human socialization. in the ‘real world’, there are no words, no concepts, nothing but the one infinite thing there only ever is. which is all of us and more.
this is so educational and in such a helpful and motivational way! thank you

China’s latest electric launch system is redefining safety and control for high-speed shuttles, capable of bringing a vehicle traveling at 170 MPH to a complete stop in just 2 seconds. 

This feat combines powerful electromagnetic braking technology with precision control systems, showcasing remarkable advances in transportation engineering. 

While this rapid deceleration is impressive, practical applications will require rigorous testing to ensure passenger comfort and system reliability. 

This breakthrough signals a future where high-speed travel is safer and more controllable than ever before. 

What impact do you think such stopping power will have on the design of future transit systems?

node.text:
When two objects appear to touch, no direct contact occurs at the atomic level.

Atoms are mostly empty space, consisting of a dense nucleus surrounded by an electron cloud. When your hand approaches a surface, the electrons in both materials begin to interact through electromagnetic forces.

Because electrons carry the same negative charge, they strongly repel each other. This repulsion creates a force that prevents atoms from occupying the same space. What we perceive as “touch” is actually the resistance created by these electromagnetic interactions.

Quantum mechanics reinforces this effect through the Pauli exclusion principle, which prevents electrons from occupying identical quantum states. This ensures that matter maintains its structure and does not collapse into itself.

What feels like physical contact is, in reality, a balance of invisible quantum forces maintaining separation.

Does knowing this change how you think about something as simple as touch?

Follow @gs.techverse for engineering and physics insights that reshape how you see reality.
Credit : @byteme_98 [YT]

#QuantumPhysics #AppliedPhysics #FundamentalPhysics #ScienceExplained #PhysicsReality

node.text:
SAVE both these cheat sheets - Vitamin Cheat Sheet and Mineral Cheat Sheet for ready reference and share with family and friends.

Quick class on Vitamins:
Vitamins are either soluble, or dissolvable, in fat or water. We describe both types below:

Fat-soluble vitamins
Vitamins A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble. The body stores fat-soluble vitamins in fatty tissue and the liver, and reserves of these vitamins can stay in the body for days and sometimes months.

Dietary fats help the body absorb fat-soluble vitamins through the intestinal tract.
A balanced diet usually provides enough fat-soluble vitamins. You may find it more difficult to get enough vitamin D from food alone and may consider taking a vitamin D supplement or a multivitamin with vitamin D in it. Talk to your doctor about it.

Water-soluble vitamins
Water-soluble vitamins do not stay in the body for long and cannot be stored. They leave the body via the urine. Because of this, people need a more regular supply of water-soluble vitamins than fat-soluble ones.

Vitamin C and all the B vitamins are water-soluble.
A balanced diet usually provides enough of these vitamins. People older than 50 and some vegetarians may need to use supplements to get enough B12. AGain discuss with your doctor about it.

Macro Minerals are the essential building blocks for a strong and resilient body. These vital nutrients play a crucial role in various bodily functions, from bone health to muscle function, and even nerve transmission. Without adequate intake, deficiency symptoms can arise, ranging from fatigue to muscle weakness. But fear not - we’ve got you covered. Our infographic highlights the critical functions of macro minerals, the common symptoms of deficiency, and the top food sources for each mineral. Discover how to harness the power of these essential nutrients and take your health to the next level!

Also,
Just to clarify:
• Nutritional yeast = B12 only if fortified
• Shiitake = not a reliable source
For vegetarians → fortified foods or supplements are key.

node.text:
In the realm of digital chaos, few things are as terrifyingly impressive as the "zip bomb." This viral Discord screenshot features a user who has allegedly created a file named funny.zip that decompresses to a staggering **55.4 Yottabytes**. To put that into perspective, the post notes that as of 2016, total global internet traffic was only about **1.1 Zettabytes** per year. This tiny 42 KB file contains enough recursive data to effectively "explode" any hardware that attempts to unextract it, filling up storage space until the system crashes.
While it’s often used as a legendary internet prank, the zip bomb is a masterclass in data compression and a stark reminder that you should never trust a random download—no matter how "funny" it claims to be. In 2026, where our lives are entirely cloud-based, a 55-yottabyte file is basically a digital black hole. Download with caution, or your hard drive might just retire early!
#ZipBomb #CyberSecurity #TechMemes #DigitalChaos #ProgrammingHumor

For context on how big a Zettabyte is that’s one trillion gigabytes and one yottabyte is 1000 zettabytes so we’re talking 55.4 yottabytes meaning that’s 55400 zettabytes which equals to 55,400,000,000,000,000 gigabytes holy shit😭💔

Could someone please tell that person to teach video game companies how to compress their data?

That’s not a close-up of a carpet. ☀️
What you’re seeing is a "hairy" view of the Sun’s chromosphere.

The dark voids are Sunspots—magnetic knots larger than Earth.
They look black only because they are 2,000 degrees cooler.

The swirling "hairs" are plasma trapped in magnetic loops.
That white-hot flash? That’s a Solar Flare igniting.
This energy release can trigger X-class solar storms.
When these magnetic fields snap, they launch billions of tons of plasma.

If aimed at Earth, they create Auroras but can also fry satellites.

We are currently approaching the Solar Maximum in 2026.

Expect more of these "monsters" to appear on the surface.

Save this if you love learning things like this.
Share this with someone who would find this fascinating.

If a solar flare knocked out the global internet for a month, what’s the first thing you’d do? 👇

node.text:
Most businesses don’t struggle with traffic.
They struggle with weak offers.

You can have the best marketing, the best content, and still not convert,  because the offer itself isn’t strong enough.

BRAND BY SID

How to make an offer people can’t refuse.

It starts with foundation.
You need deep clarity on your ideal client, their biggest problems, and the exact outcome they want. If this isn’t clear, everything else feels generic.

Then comes value creation.
Your offer should promise a clear transformation, not just a service. Add bonuses, stack value, and make the perception of what they’re getting feel far greater than what they’re paying.

Next is offer structure.
Keep it simple. Specific deliverables. Clear pricing. Strong guarantees. Confusion kills conversions — clarity closes deals.

Then comes presentation.
Your headline, your messaging, your copy. Focus on benefits, not features. Remove objections before they come up. Create urgency so people actually act.

But the real difference is in execution.

You research the market.
Position your offer differently.
Design it around outcomes.
Write copy that makes it easy to say yes.
Launch with intent.
Deliver an experience that exceeds expectations.
Then optimize based on real data and scale.

Average offers compete.
Strong offers convert.
Great offers dominate.

#entrepreneurship #marketingstrategy #salesstrategy #digitalcreator #businessgrowth

The idea is simple:
Right now, companies want experience.
But without opportunities, how do students or beginners actually gain that experience?
Marks don’t define skills. Resumes don’t show real capability.
DreamStack is focused on solving that —
by helping people work on real projects and turn that into verified proof of work that companies and institutions can trust.
Still in early stage. Looking for:
– Builders
– Teammates
– Guidance
– People who believe in solving real problems
If this connects with you, feel free to DM.

Image credit- @gravitonomy
Nuance against binary - This digital artifact captures a quintessential intersection of the modern culture war, pitting biological essentialism against scientific complexity. The initial post represents a common political rhetoric that attempts to reduce human sex to a rigid, binary "common sense" to dismiss contemporary gender discourse. By using the phrase "Biology doesn't care about your feelings," the user attempts to claim the authority of objective truth to simplify a complex subject. The response, however, functions as an intellectual "counter-strike," utilizing an exhaustive list of chromosomal variations to prove that biological reality is far more diverse than a simple XX/XY split. It reflects a social shift where specialized medical and scientific data are being weaponized in everyday digital spaces to dismantle political slogans.
The humor style is rooted in academic snark and the "well, actually" corrective. The second user employs a "textual wall" of clinical data to physically and intellectually overwhelm the first poster’s short, punchy claim. The closing remark, "Class dismissed," adds a layer of performative superiority, framing the interaction as a lesson for an uneducated student. In terms of internet culture, this reflects the "ratio" phenomenon, where a rebuttal gains more traction than the original post by exposing its flaws with overwhelming evidence. It highlights a digital anthropology where "truth" is no longer a shared foundation, but a battlefield where simple categories are constantly challenged by the messy, technical reality of human biology.
@cvllue facts do not care about your opinions at all.

This is a simplified explanation of Apple’s Unified Memory. In reality, performance depends on multiple factors beyond just memory architecture. Apple’s efficiency also comes from its ARM based architecture, high memory bandwidth, tight CPU, GPU and Neural Engine integration, and deep hardware and software optimization.

Also, unified or shared memory is not entirely new. Many systems with integrated GPUs already use it, but Apple has implemented it in a more optimized way.

Actual performance can vary depending on workload, software optimization, and overall system design.

F1 Racing Coming Back to India 🔥👇
Big motorsport momentum for India’s future! 🇮🇳🏎️
The government is actively pushing to bring F1 back to the Buddh International Circuit in Greater Noida — the same world-class track that hosted the Indian Grand Prix from 2011 to 2013. Talks are underway to resolve tax hurdles, improve management, and host the world’s biggest racing spectacle again.

This revival isn’t just sports — it’s global branding, tourism growth, infrastructure excellence, and international confidence. India’s rising economy and youthful fanbase make it a huge opportunity.
This is part of Modi government’s Viksit Bharat vision — making India a global stage for world events!

Follow for sports, infrastructure, and global wins! 🚀
#india #formula1 #f1racing

The Sacred & The Profane: Mysticism, Comparative Religion & Sacred Texts 

———

MYXfamily is a living user manual we’re writing for our kids; a record of how we think, decide, and build.

Our carousels capture moments and ideas, not complete systems or finished conclusions.

Shared as documentation, not direction.

BUDDHA, THE GREEK PHILOSOPHERS, AND JESUS CHRIST WERE ALL HEAVILY INFLUENCED BY JAINISM.

Jainism has been the greatest force for good in the world.  Mankind’s INNER REVOLUTION began and achieved its original and clearest form in Jainism, where the path to self-realization was first established.  The reality is that THE WHOLE WORLD LOVES JAIN IDEAS, AND JAIN IDEAS CHANGED THE WORLD.  Buddhism is an offshoot of Jainism and the Hindus, Greeks and early Christian ascetics were all deeply affected by the example and teachings of the Jain monks.  Jainism is here to make you the master of your life, not just one of a billion slaves of a mythical deity.  That requires you to cultivate your mind, body and soul, and that is what the Jain lifestyle brings to your reality. JAYA JAYA JINA SHASAN!!! JAYA JAYA TIRTHANKAR BHAGAVAN!!! 🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾

Jainism is the main source of many of the ideas that many people call “spirituality” today. Western philosophy begins with Jainism, which is what inspired Pythagoras and other Greek philosophers who went to India, and studied under the Gymnosophists, or naked sages, who were the Jain monks. Jainism existed in ancient Palestine and northern Egypt in the form of the Greek Cynics and the Gymnosophists, according to numerous classical sources.  Jesus Christ was directly or indirectly influenced by Jainism, and a certain Jain parable appears twice in the New Testament Gospels. Buddhism is an offshoot of Jainism. Hinduism took many ideas from Jainism which first began to appear in the Upanishads which mention many non-Vedic ideas, such as reincarnation, karma, sansara, and self-realization which came from Jainism. Yoga philosophy and practice have a lot of Jain influence.  Gandhi’s non-violence came directly from Jain influence.  All roads of the spiritual path ultimately lead to ideas that originated in Jainism.

node.text:
How Satellites 📡 Are Hacked by Hackers

Satellite systems are not just space infrastructure — they are part of the invisible cyber backbone of the modern world.
From GPS navigation to military communication and global internet routing, everything depends on signals traveling through open space and complex ground networks. From a hacker’s perspective, any system that relies on wireless transmission, trust-based communication, and layered protocols becomes an exploitable surface.

Attackers don’t “break into space” — they study signals, analyze communication patterns, and target weak points in ground stations, misconfigurations, and outdated security implementations.

The real risk is not the satellite itself — it’s the ecosystem built around it.

Understanding this layer means understanding how modern cyber-physical systems truly work.

If you want to learn this in depth, follow me for more hacking analysis or join my premium Telegram channel — link is in bio.

Satellite systems operate on layered communication (uplink/downlink) using RF signals, ground stations, and secure control protocols. In real cybersecurity research, the focus is on signal security, encryption strength, and infrastructure resilience — not “instant hacking,” but analyzing how these complex systems can be studied, monitored, and protected against potential vulnerabilities.

Ever wondered why you studied trigonometry in school? A skilled machinist in his workshop shows exactly how it powers real precision work on a lathe machine. 

He carefully measures the base as 130 mm and the hypotenuse as 135 mm for a taper setup, then applies the simple formula: cos θ = base / hypotenuse. 

Calculating cos θ = 130/135 ≈ 0.963, he finds θ ≈ 16.26° on his scientific calculator and sets this angle on the compound slide to machine a perfect taper. 

With calm, step-by-step explanation, the video turns textbook math into practical metalworking skill that engineers and fitters use every day. It’s a powerful reminder that basic concepts like cosine have direct, hands-on value in professional trades.

Planting Sand Extract

Communities are manipulated rather than nurtured; mutual aid becomes overshadowed by the heavy hand of surveillance. Citizens, unaware of their collective power, never challenge the narratives crafted by those who seek to profit from their desperation. Because you can never stop people once they start. 
Because you can never stop people once they start…

Core Principles from Boris Cherny’s CLAUDEmd are the cheat code.

Simplicity first, smallest change that ships,
No laziness, find root causes and leave no patches,
Minimal impact, touch only what the task needs,
Plan mode for anything past three steps,
Elegance check before I call work done ✅

This one file alone is why my Claude Code is vibemaxxinggg.

Comment “MD” to grab the full playbook.

Some people don’t take “no” personally.

They just look for another manager 😄

In Dubai, there’s always another level.

Another yacht. Another opportunity. Another “yes.” 🚤

Yacht season here never disappoints. 🌊✨

Tell me — are you the one who accepts “no” or the one who finds a way?

Write it in the comments.�Best comment will be pinned 📌

11 Trillion litres of water is being used for this purpose and 800 billion litres is complete fresh water!

Solutions:
•	Air/dry cooling
•	Recycled or wastewater use
•	Closed-loop systems
•	Shift to renewables

Why companies don’t:
•	Higher upfront cost
•	Less efficient in hot climates
•	Water is cheap & under-regulated
•	Old infrastructure is hard to change

Reality:
The tech exists. The incentive doesn’t.

The water is not disappeared after evaporation, it falls back as rain but mostly into the ocean as land is very small on earth, and again the salt water cannot be used, the % of pure water reduces.
This is not anything against AI but about becoming more sustainable which we already are, and grow more into technology and make better systems that run on minimal resources.

The hot water is sometimes put into water bodies which kills many organisms, again damaging the environment and causing thermal pollution.

#news #business #ai #viral water
the underbelly of our society is looking more and more like the dystopian films every day

The major issue gonna be arise in next 5 to 6 yrs, as we have very limited freshwater on earth, that is why treating wastewater becomes super important. For country like ours India, where population is 1/4th of world, and have only 4% fresh water reserve. Major challenge gonna coming as these massive data centers and industrial development are gonna happen.

Can’t we find anything else rather than just water??
Solar powered energy which can be used to get a cold system for them

Or they just don’t care
Yet you are posting using the same system. Hypocrites. Not defending it though but your whole identity is build on these systems.

I’m a huge environmentalist and the spike in data centers and other computer server buildings in the water they use is concerning. However, many systems these days are getting better and better at recycling the water they use. Because water is expensive. Again, I’m not saying that makes it right. I’m just saying that is something people should probably know.. for example I know one video a lot of their fabrication labs for computer chips can reclaim up to 90% of the water. Also as our green energy sources, get better and better desalinating ocean water becomes more and more feasible.
This is how they genocide you with you even NOTICING
Here's where the Water Wars begin.
@vishaladvani1 it’s actually a much bigger issue most modern data centers are closed loop cooling like a car radiator so the water usage isn’t terrible it’s the massive power drain that’s an issue
@bizbrat which is arguably more sustainable cause it evaporates when in contact with the servers heat creates clouds and it then rains again it’s called the water cycle

Someone's lack of control is not your responsibility
And Character isnt a gender thing.

@hella_anxious1 and what if one doesn't cover to fit in your definition of modesty? What exactly is modesty and immodesty for you and Islam? Lowering and raising gaze based on clothing is anyways illogical for anyone since Clothing is a personal choice and differs for everyone.
@hella_anxious1 he's not misguiding anyone tho. He's stating a fact. If someone does not want to cover up, or if someone doesn't lower his gaze, it's on them.

STOP Scratching Like That! 🛑 
Caption: That “itch” isn’t just dry skin—it’s likely a fungus (aka Jock Itch) 🍄. As a doctor, I see this daily, especially in active folks.
Why it happens: Warm, moist environments + fungi = 😫.
What to do:
1️⃣ Stop sharing towels.
2️⃣ Wear cotton underwear.
3️⃣ Get an antifungal cream 💊.
If it doesn’t clear in 2 weeks, see a pro! 🧑‍⚕️
Share with a friend who needs to see this!

The PSP was launched by Sony in 2004–2005 and was truly ahead of its time.

This device didn’t just play games, it could also play movies, music, and even browse the internet, making it more like a portable entertainment system at a time when most handhelds were far more limited.

The video you’re seeing was shared by @/Azadux on X, and he mentioned that the device was almost 80% full of games, yet still this smooth.

300 new followers from posting this content! Thank you for the love 🤍 thought to share it here. 

Back to topic: 

AI is about to create one of the fastest growing types of entrepreneur
And you’re either learning this… or waiting for the next wave.

For the first time ever…
One person can run what used to need a full team.
Not because they work harder.
Because they use leverage.

You don’t need 10 employees anymore.

You need a system. A system that generates you and your clients revenue. 

And this is what that system looks like:
1️⃣ Lead Generation
You use tools like scraping
to find businesses that already need help.

2️⃣ Lead Qualification
You filter who is actually worth talking to.
Not every lead is a good lead.
This saves time.

3️⃣ CRM
You organize everything in one place.
So no leads get lost.
Because lost leads means lost revenue for businesses

4️⃣ Follow-Up Automation
Most businesses lose money here.
Leads come in…
But nobody follows up properly.

So you build systems that:
• send messages
• remind
• nurture

Automatically.

5️⃣ 24/7 Voice Receptionist
When someone calls? They don’t miss it.
Because AI answers it- human like voice - ElevenLabs. 
Handles basic questions.
Books appointments.
Even while you sleep.

Now step back and look at this.
This is what businesses actually want:
• more leads
• faster responses
• no missed opportunities
• more revenue

AI is what builds the system.
Sales is what tells you what to build.

Because if you don’t understand:
• where money is coming from
• where money is being lost

You’re just building random automations.

And random doesn’t get clients hooked on your offer.

I’m executing while sharing my journey. Because confidence is reclaimed through repetition, proximity and consistency. 

Cold calls. Real businesses. Real problems.
While sharing what I learn.

I’m not special.
I’m just someone who started.
And you can do the same.

Here’s the catch, it’s 30 years until AI dominates all gaps. 
 
With the market change and abrupt pacing, so will how systems are built 

Follow Along to see how I automate email outreach to clients -> getting them booked.

🧠 POV: You thought ships disappear in the ocean…

But reality hits different.

They don’t vanish.
They broadcast themselves.

Every. Single. Second.

📡 Location
⚡ Speed
🆔 Identity
🏁 Destination

Not hacking.
Not magic.

Just OSINT.

The same data used by:
• Governments
• Analysts
• Journalists
• Investigators

And yes…
you can access it too (legally).

But here’s the part nobody talks about 👇

Powerful data in the wrong hands = risk

They see ships…
You see patterns

They see maps…
You see intelligence

💻 Data > Assumptions
🔍 OSINT > Guesswork
🛡️ Ethics > Exploitation

Real ones don’t just track—
they understand.

Because cybersecurity isn’t about breaking things…
It’s about seeing what others ignore.

📌 SAVE this if you didn’t know ships are trackable
📤 SHARE with someone who thinks hacking = illegal only
👀 FOLLOW @rootxploit.0x for real OSINT mindset

🧠 The internet doesn’t hide information…
It hides it in plain sight.

node.text:
The Boys is a dark action drama series that shows a twisted version of superheroes. In this world, superheroes are not always good—they are powerful, corrupt, and often dangerous behind the scenes.
The story follows a group of normal people who decide to expose and fight these fake heroes. Led by a ruthless man, they take on the most powerful superhero team, risking their lives to reveal the truth.
Filled with intense action, shocking moments, and dark humor, the series breaks the typical superhero image and shows what power can really do to people. It’s brutal, unpredictable, and full of crazy twists.
Creator:-
Eric Kripke
Cast:-
Karl Urban
Antony Starr
Jack Quaid
Streaming Platform:-
Amazon Prime Video

node.text: #🇳🇴 トロムソ（北極圏特集）が「ミッドナイトサン・ウィスパー・ネットワーク」を導入しました！ これは1基12kW、合計564kWの47基のマイクロ風力タービンを屋上やフィヨルド沿いに分散設置し、北極圏の一年中吹き続ける強風を利用して380世帯分のクリーンエネルギーを供給するものです。トロムソは世界初の冬季電力需要の23％を分散型マイクロ風力でまかなう亜北極都市となりました！⛰️💨⚡️🌌🏔️ この革新的なシステムにより、年間1,200トンの二酸化炭素排出が削減され、静かな景観を守りながら持続可能な都市づくりを実現しています。 トロムソは北極の絶え間ない風を街の灯りへと変え、ノルウェーのフィヨルドに未来のエネルギーを届けています。🇳🇴 北極圏の果てでも風は力になる — トロムソは、地域に寄り添う分散型エネルギーが寒冷地の暮らしを支えられることを証明しています！ 🌬️💚 #Tromsø #Norway #WindEnergy #MidnightSunWhisperNetwork ArcticInnovation ClimateAction RenewableNorway SustainableFjords
$2500 promo code in my story btw

node.text:
House playlist link in bio 💿

عام 1998 من تأليف وإخراج الأخوين كوين من بطولة جيف بريدجز الذي قام بدور جيف ليباوسكي وهو رجل من لوس انجلوس عاطل عن العمل وهو لاعب بولينج شره وبعد مشكلة بسبب تشابه الأسماء اختطفت زوجة ميليونير يدعى جيفري ليباوسكي وأستدعى المليونير جيف ليباوسكي لحل المشكلة وكلفه بتوصيل الفدية للخاطفين من أجل إطلاق سراح زوجته، ولكن تزداد الأمور سوءا عندما يقرر صديق ليباوسكي والتر سوبتشاك الذي قام بدوره جون غودمان بالأحتفاظ بالفدية.

الفيلم في غطى تكاليفه (15 مليون دولار) بتحقيقه عائدات تساوي (46 مليون دولار). هذه الارقام ليست عالية خصوصا ان الفيلم اشترك فيه العديد من النجوم و فنيا لم يلقى الكثير من الصيت، ولكن بعد ذلك تحولت الآراء النقدية وقيمته تقييما إيجابيا وأصبح الفيلم أيقونه ثقافية وأصبح له جماهيرية واسعة، وفي عام 2002 كرس بعض محبي الفيلم من مدينة لويفيل كنتاكي جهودهم لإنشاء مهرجان خاص بعشاق الفيلم. في العام 2014, اختارت مكتبة الكونغرس إضافة الفيلم إلى مجموعة (السجل الوطني للأفــلام) المرموقة لما له من تأثير ثقافي و فني.

That’s such a wholesome story! Sometimes, a child’s perspective is exactly the reminder we need that the world can be a much kinder and more imaginative place than we often give it credit for.

In a world that can sometimes feel heavy, it’s the small, unfiltered moments of childhood wonder that truly brighten our day. This beautiful story reminds us that while we, as adults, often carry the weight of labels, misunderstandings, and societal expectations, children see the world through a much simpler, more magical lens.

When a young boy spent his time at the supermarket staring at a woman in her traditional hijab and jilbab, it would have been easy to assume the worst. We’ve become so conditioned to expect judgment or discomfort. Instead, this little "feller" wasn't seeing a stranger or someone different—he was convinced he was in the presence of a real-life superhero. His loud, enthusiastic whisper of "I LOVE YOU BATMAN" is a perfect example of pure, innocent joy.

It’s a powerful lesson in perspective. Where we see difference, children often see wonder. This moment of connection, sparked by a toddler’s imagination, turned what could have been an awkward encounter into a memory filled with warmth and a bit of "Caped Crusader" magic. Let’s all try to look at each other with a little more of that wide-eyed wonder today.

#wholesomemoments #humanity #superherovibes #childhoodwonder #kindnessmatters

Fact: Manolete (2008) This biographical drama tells the tragic life story of the legendary Spanish bullfighter Manuel Rodriguez Sanchez, known as Manolete, and his tumultuous love affair with the actress Lupe Sino.

The film faced a notoriously difficult production journey and was delayed for several years due to financial disputes and legal issues, leading many to believe it would never see a theatrical release. 

Despite featuring Academy Award winners Adrien Brody and Penelope Cruz, the movie was met with mixed reviews, though critics widely praised Brody’s physical transformation and striking resemblance to the real-life matador.

A notable detail about the production is that Adrien Brody underwent rigorous training with professional bullfighters to ensure his movements in the ring were authentic, even though the film heavily utilized digital effects to recreate the bulls and maintain safety on set.

node.text: This meme shows a flight attendant in a red uniform rushing down an airplane aisle in panic, only to trip and fall after overhearing the pilot accidentally confess over the mic that he plans to flirt with her after landing — it plays on the chaos that unfolds when private thoughts become public, turning authority into embarrassment and urgency into comedy. The situation builds on anticipation versus reality, where her frantic reaction feels justified until a child’s innocent comment undercuts everything, exposing how humans often overreact before events even happen. It reflects how we let imagination amplify situations, especially when ego or fear is involved, and how quickly seriousness can collapse into humor. In a world where everything is instantly heard, shared, and misinterpreted, the real punchline isn’t the pilot — it’s how we react before anything even happens.

node.text:
Como os agricultores separam os grãos de trigo da poeira e da palha sem máquinas? 🤯

O truque utiliza princípios simples da física. Os grãos de trigo, mais pesados, caem rapidamente porque a gravidade os puxa para baixo com mais força, enquanto as partículas de poeira, mais leves, permanecem suspensas no ar em movimento.

Uma ponte de malha ou peneira ajuda a filtrar os materiais com base no tamanho das partículas, permitindo que a poeira menor passe, enquanto retém os grãos maiores.

Este processo tradicional é um exemplo perfeito de como a gravidade, o fluxo de ar e a separação de partículas trabalham juntos no dia a dia.

física da separação de trigo e poeira, método tradicional de limpeza de grãos, separação de grãos por gravidade, ciência da separação de palha, malha de filtragem por tamanho de partícula, exemplo de física agrícola, processo de classificação de grãos agrícolas, física da separação por densidade, limpeza de grãos por fluxo de ar, método tradicional de limpeza de trigo, técnica agrícola simples baseada na física, demonstração de ciência agrícola, vídeos curtos de física agrícola

Este vídeo tem apenas fins educativos e motivacionais e utiliza alguns trechos sob a doutrina do uso justo para explicar a ciência de forma envolvente.

Directed by Glenn Ficarra and John Requa, "Focus" (2015) is a stylish crime drama that blends romance with high-stakes cons. The story follows Nicky Spurgeon, a seasoned con artist, who takes novice grifter Jess under his wing. As their partnership grows into romance, trust and betrayal collide, leading to a dangerous game of manipulation when they cross paths years later in Buenos Aires. 

The film stars Will Smith as Nicky and Margot Robbie as Jess, with supporting performances from Rodrigo Santoro, Adrian Martinez, and BD Wong. Known for its sharp dialogue, glamorous settings, and twist-filled plot, "Focus" explores themes of trust, deception, and the blurred line between love and lies. 

How would you rate this film out of 10? 💭

node.text: 🎬 Tikdam (2024) 🎥 Genre & Themes Tikdam is a family-oriented Hindi drama that blends slice-of-life storytelling with emotional and social themes — especially the bond between parents and children, small-town struggles, migration to bigger cities, and even subtle ecological messages about community and environment. 👨‍👩‍👧 Main Cast Amit Sial as Prakash (the father) Arisht Jain as Samay (son) Aarohi Saud as Cheeni (daughter) Divyansh Dwivedi as Bhanu (friend of the kids) Nayan Bhatt as Daadi (grandmother) Ajit Sarwotam Kelkar as Dadu (grandfather) Jeniffer Piccinato as Rose (hotel owner) 🧑‍🔧 Crew Director: Vivek Anchalia Story By: Animesh Verma Writers: Pankaj Nihalani, Vivek Anchalia Producer(s): Jyoti Deshpande, Parth Gajjar, Poonam Shroff, Savio Shenoy, Shweta Sharma Anchalia Cinematography: Parth Sayani Music: Daniel B. George 📖 Plot Summary The film centers on Prakash, a humble father who works at a hotel in a quiet hill town.

node.text:
The video provides a fascinating aerial perspective on the art of racing, specifically highlighting the stark contrast between a standard driving line and the high-performance "F1 line." While a casual driver might hug the inner curb or follow a wider, more intuitive path (shown in red), the F1-style approach (shown in green) prioritizes momentum and late-apex turns. By utilizing every inch of the track’s width and late-braking into the corners, the F1 line maximizes exit speed, allowing the car to carry significantly more velocity onto the straights. This visual breakdown serves as a masterclass in physics and precision, demonstrating that the fastest way around a track isn't always the shortest distance, but rather the path that maintains the highest average speed. It is a testament to the split-second decision-making and technical mastery required to compete at the pinnacle of motorsport.

node.text:
Most people fly drones without knowing what’s actually inside them.
Here’s everything explained simply. 🚁
Flight Controller (FC) — The brain. Processes thousands of inputs per second keeping the drone stable. Without it the drone would flip and crash in milliseconds.
4-in-1 ESC — Electronic Speed Controller. Translates the flight controller’s commands into actual motor speed. One controls all four motors simultaneously.
4 Brushless Motors — Each spinning thousands of RPM. Opposite motors spin in opposite directions to prevent the whole drone from spinning itself.
FPV Camera — First Person View. Sends live video to your goggles so you see exactly what the drone sees in real time.
Control Receiver (RX) — Picks up signals from your radio controller. Loses signal and the drone activates failsafe mode automatically.
XT60 Battery Connector — The power gateway. Handles massive current spikes during aggressive manoeuvres without melting.
Power Capacitor — Smooths out voltage spikes protecting the electronics from sudden power surges.
Video Antenna — Transmits live FPV feed. Better antenna means clearer video at longer range.
Every component working together at hundreds of decisions per second.
That’s how something this small moves like that. ⚡️

This viral clip captures a quintessential “mic drop” moment that has circulated through meme culture for its sheer audacity and unexpected wordplay. In what appears to be a freestyle rap battle or a public confrontation, a young man asserts his dominance with a bizarrely clinical insult that catches both his opponent and the surrounding crowd completely off guard. By combining a classic street-style territorial claim—“This is my area”—with a sudden pivot into a joke about personal hygiene and microbiology, the speaker creates a comedic juxtaposition. The crowd’s reaction, shifting from intense anticipation to shocked laughter, underscores how the “bacteria” line subverts the typical aggressive tropes of these environments, replacing standard bravado with a hilarious, left-field roast.
The video’s enduring popularity stems from its raw, unfiltered energy and the perfect delivery of its nonsensical yet sharp punchline. While most verbal spats rely on heavy profanity or physical intimidation, this specific interaction leans into the “absurdist” humor that thrives on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels. The irony of being “afraid” of an opponent not out of fear of violence, but out of fear of germs, transforms a potentially tense situation into a lighthearted piece of internet history. It serves as a reminder that in the world of viral content, a unique and unpredictable insult often carries more weight—and staying power—than a standard tough-guy act.

回想首次觀影時，那些高速飛行與極限測試的畫面至今仍令人心跳加速，沒想到這麼快就能再次在大銀幕上重溫這份震撼。
電影將鏡頭對準平日鮮少被關注的空軍試飛員，真實呈現新型戰機在正式服前所經歷的嚴苛試驗過程。為了獲取精準數據，他們不斷逼近飛行安全邊界，在極端狀態下完成高風險任務，用意志與勇氣直面未知與死亡。
影片中，多款中國現役尖端戰機真機亮相，包括殲-20、殲-16、殲-10C。戰機破雲而出、俯衝翻轉，動作乾淨俐落，配合震撼的引擎轟鳴聲，回想首次觀影時，那些高速飛行與極限測試的畫面至今仍令人心跳加速，沒想到這麼快就能再次在大銀幕上重溫這份震撼。

📈📉#🇯🇵 当达到这种速度时，已经不再是地面移动，而是以音速前进🚀🌍 
这段模拟展示了如果以马赫1（约1330公里/小时）的速度乘坐超音速列车穿越日本，会是一种怎样的体验。 
目前，日本最快的列车运行速度约为320公里/小时。

node.text:
🚀⚡ماذا لو كان مستقبل النقل موجود بالفعل في اليابان؟ .

في اليابان، أنشأ المهندسون قطارات رفع مغناطيسية فائقة التطور يمكنها التحرك دون حتى لمس المسارات.

بدلاً من استخدام العجلات العادية، تطفو هذه القطارات المستقبلية قليلاً فوق السكك الحديدية باستخدام قوى مغناطيسية قوية. هذا يزيل كل الاحتكاك تقريبا ويسمح لهم بالوصول إلى سرعات لا تصدق تشعر أنها أقرب للطيران من السفر.

لقد تجاوزت بعض قطارات الاختبار هذه بالفعل 600 كم/ ساعة، مما يجعلها من أسرع القطارات التي تم بناؤها على الإطلاق. بهذه السرعة، يمكن أن تشعر مدن بأكملها أقرب بكثير من أي وقت مضى.

ما يجعل هذا أكثر إثارة للإعجاب هو مدى سلاسة الرحلة وصامتة، وتحويل النقل إلى شيء يشعر مباشرة من فيلم الخيال العلمي.

اليابان تثبت أن المستقبل لن يأتي قريبًا... في بعض الأماكن، إنها موجودة بالفعل.🌎🚀

node.text:
Not referring to supplements, but the hormones and nutrients themselves

☀️ Vitamin D is called a vitamin but it's technically a hormone your body produces when exposed to sunlight

Vitamin D is involved with almost all processes in the body, such as regulation if the immune system, calcium metabolism, energy production and cardiovascular function

💪 B vitamins are a group o vitamins that affect nerve and cellular functioning. They are central to energy and nervous system activity

🪨 Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in your body and is responsible for the function of over 350 enzymes in your body. 

It stabilizes blood pressure, strengthens bones, provides neuroprotection, and allows your nerves to function properly

🌘 Melatonin is the most powerful antioxidant and longevity hormone

Melatonin is specifically a mitochondria targeted antioxidant where most of oxidative stress is created (PMID: 27500468)

Melatonin is a master regulator of cell death and inflammation (PMID: 29902071)

With age your melatonin levels decrease significantly (PMID: 9951620)

Which leaves you vulnerable to age related diseases

In puberty your body makes about 1 mg of melatonin per night

During adulthood it drops to 0.3 mg and 0.1 mg in elderhood

There's a big gap between what's optimal and what's there.

⚡️NAD is the main coenzyme in the body that you need for every cellular function and energy production

Follow @siimland
Deficiency of vitamin D can literally cause you death. Don't ignore the signs
Please give link for good D3 clinical studies
Convince me that melatonin is really a practical antioxidant
So remaining all are slaves and you are not taking care of slaves abolish slavery
Glutathione is the body's primary Master Antioxidant.

I've been trying to get my Vitamin D up naturally while losing weight, and seeing the macros for it helps. I thought tracking would make me obsessive, but it made me more relaxed since the app is so low-effort. It's on my profile if you want to just snap a pic of your meals to see your nutrients

node.text:
Köpeğiyle birlikte yaptığı yürüyüşlerde kedisinin neler yaptığını merak eden adam, kedinin hareketlerini takip etmek için ona GPS cihazı kurmaya karar verdi. Topladığı verileri analiz ederken kedinin yolculuk boyunca gizlice onları takip ettiğini, yakında ama görüş alanı dışında kalarak onları şaşırttığını keşfetti.

Bu davranış, kedilerin bağımsız ve aynı zamanda bağlı doğasını vurgular. Genellikle yalnız hayvanlar olarak kabul edilseler de kediler, sahipleri ve evdeki diğer hayvanlarla güçlü bağlar geliştirebilirler. Kedinin sahibine ve köpeğe eşlik etmesi, koruma içgüdüsüne veya muhtemelen uzaktan da olsa aile faaliyetlerine katılma arzusuna işaret eder.

Evcil hayvanlar üzerinde GPS takip cihazlarının kullanımı giderek yaygınlaşıyor ve bu da sahiplerinin evcil hayvanlarının hareketlerini izlemelerine ve güvenliklerini sağlamalarına olanak tanıyor. Bu cihazlar, hayvanların keşfettiği alışkanlıklar ve bölgeler hakkında değerli bilgiler sağlayarak davranışlarını ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamaya yardımcı oluyor.

Kedilerinde GPS takip cihazı kullanmak isteyenler için, hayvanın büyüklüğüne uygun, hafif ve konforlu cihazlar seçmek ve kullanımın rahatsızlık veya strese neden olmadığından emin olmak önemlidir. Ayrıca, güvenilir veriler elde etmek için pil ömrünü ve izlemenin doğruluğunu kontrol etmek de önemlidir.

The video captures a humorous and highly energetic "gym fail" that quickly transitions into a display of unexpected agility and showmanship. It begins with a man performing a dramatic, high-velocity movement on a sit-up bench that causes the equipment to tip over backward. Rather than falling or showing signs of distress, the man uses the momentum to execute a seamless, acrobatic recovery, landing back on his feet almost instantly.
He immediately leans into the absurdity of the moment, breaking into a confident, synchronized dance routine to the aggressive rhythm of DMX’s "X Gon' Give It To Ya." The two women in the background are seen watching with a mix of confusion and amusement, highlighting the contrast between the chaotic accident and his composed performance. The clip perfectly encapsulates a "main character energy" vibe, where a potential mishap is transformed into a viral-worthy stunt through quick reflexes and comedic timing.

node.text: The Islamic world was a lot more complex and nuanced than people often assume.
Alcohol is purely dangerous. I hate that they are even compared. That is inordinate sobriety.
I can understand medicinal use of hashish topically or in food for chronic pain, but daily wake and bake? That’s wild.
@veli_daaa I'm not talking about an allergy, I'm talking about the side effects of a drug, and yes scientifically caffeine is classified as a drug, one of the most commonly used addictive drugs

node.text: This video features a high-speed train, likely a Japanese Maglev, hurtling through a landscape at incredible velocities. The Persian caption notes that at these speeds, the vehicle essentially stops "rolling" on the ground and moves with the efficiency and intensity of sound. The footage captures the blur of the surroundings, emphasizing the technological marvel of frictionless travel. It’s a glimpse into the future of transportation, where magnetic levitation eliminates traditional rail friction, allowing for speeds that could eventually rival commercial aircraft, fundamentally changing how we perceive distance and travel time.

node.text:
Bro's lunch break is 58 seconds 😂

This Instagram Reel captures the frantic, blink-and-you’ll-miss-it reality of the modern hustle.

The clip, filmed through a car window in a rainy city, features a young man in a purple jersey who has clearly mastered the art of the "micro-break." With a text overlay reading “Bro’s lunch break 58 seconds 😭,” the video shows him simultaneously chugging an orange drink and shoving food into his mouth while walking briskly through traffic. It’s a masterclass in efficiency that feels both impressive and deeply stressful to watch.

What makes the video resonate isn't just the speed—it's the relatability. In an era of "quiet quitting" and "hustle culture," this 10-second snippet personifies the feeling of having zero downtime. The creator frames the moment with a mix of pity and awe, using the "crying" and "folded hands" emojis to turn a mundane moment of a stranger’s day into a viral symbol of the daily grind.

Engagement on the post reflects a collective "I've been there" sentiment. Viewers are flooding the comments with jokes about their own short breaks and the struggle of balancing a job with the basic human need to eat. The grainy, candid nature of the footage adds an authentic "street-level" feel that Gen Z audiences crave, making it feel less like a staged skit and more like a genuine sighting of a "main character" in the wild.

For a global audience, the subtext is clear: we are all working too hard. Whether you're a student rushing between classes or a delivery driver on a tight schedule, the "58-second lunch" is a universal language. The video serves as a digital mirror, reflecting the high-speed pressure of 2026 where even a deep breath—or a sip of juice—has to be optimized for time

node.text:
The clip unfolds in a split second. A girl steps off a bike, balance slips, and both go down together. Before the moment can even register, a group of boys rushes in, not toward the fallen rider, but straight to the bike. The comedy writes itself without a single word.

What makes it funnier is the instinctive reaction. The bike is lifted, checked, and stabilized with full focus, while the girl remains on the ground for a beat longer than expected. Priorities are loud and clear, driven by reflex rather than logic.

This reel perfectly captures a classic truth of bike culture. For many riders, the machine comes first, and moments like these turn everyday chaos into viral humor.

Love bikes? Follow @motomationmedia
